data.narrative: Built all three observability pillars - JSON structured logging with request correlation, Prometheus metrics with a /metrics endpoint, and three alert rules - then diagnosed and fixed two real blind spots: a broken request_id thread in the redirect hot path and an instrument middleware that silently dropped 500 metrics on exceptions.

dimension_scores.observation: Every log line now emits level, message, service_name, request_id as JSON; inbound X-Request-ID is honored; metrics expose counters by method/path/status, duration histogram buckets, an active_requests gauge, and process metrics.
dimension_scores.evidence: curl /metrics shows http_requests_total{method='GET',path='/r/test123',status='500'} 1.0, histogram buckets le='0.005'..'+Inf', active_requests, process_cpu_seconds_total; logs show full request journey with request_id=journey-fix-1.

dimension_scores.observation: Proactively tested all three BREAK scenarios (silent failure, cardinality bomb, missing request_id) and proved the missing-correlation scenario by correlating cache events to requests during a burst.
dimension_scores.evidence: Detected linkops.redirect plain-text lines with no request_id; verified only 6 metric time series (no cardinality bomb) and no null request_ids.

dimension_scores.observation: Kept graceful degradation logs (cache fallback, click enqueue drop) structured and request-correlated, so failures in degraded paths remain diagnosable.
dimension_scores.evidence: cache.py and analytics.py warnings now route through shared _log with context fields; verified click enqueue and cache fallback warnings are JSON with code/event_key context.

dimension_scores.observation: Added prometheus-client to requirements with a pinned version and rebuilt the compose image cleanly, integrating the /metrics endpoint into the existing healthcheck topology.
dimension_scores.evidence: requirements.txt includes prometheus-client==0.23.1; /live /ready /metrics all return 200 after rebuild.

dimension_scores.observation: Kept the observability additions inside the existing single image - no extra services, no baked config - consistent with the Module 3 env-separation decisions.
dimension_scores.evidence: compose api container unchanged in structure; no .env in image; /metrics served from the same container.

dimension_scores.observation: Documented the three alert rules in Prometheus YAML with expression, threshold, for-duration, severity, message, and runbook link - a complete on-call contract.
dimension_scores.evidence: observability/prometheus-alerts.yml with HighErrorRate, HighLatency, ServiceDown rules.

strengths: Diagnosed the missing request_id thread by isolating one request's journey during a burst - the exact skill the module teaches.
Found and fixed the silent-metrics blind spot where exceptions skipped the metric increment entirely.
Consolidated all logging into one shared structured module, eliminating format drift across redirect/cache/jobs loggers.
data.recommendation: Before Module 5, decide what each alert's message should say to the on-call engineer and add escalation paths to the runbook - the alert YAML is complete but the runbook links are placeholders.

public_evidence.student_action: Extracted a shared structured logger and wired every request/response pair, error path, redirect cache event, and background job through it with request_id correlation.
public_evidence.technical_detail: log() emits level/message/service_name/request_id JSON; access_log middleware honors X-Request-ID; redirect router pulls request_id from request.state.
public_evidence.proof: Two redirects with X-Request-ID journey-fix-1/2 produce correlated 'request received' -> 'redirect cache hit' -> 'response sent' lines sharing each request_id.
public_evidence.reviewer_value: Proves the ability to trace a single request across every log line - foundational for production debugging.

public_evidence.student_action: Exposed GET /metrics with Prometheus counters, histograms, a business gauge, and process metrics; fixed the middleware so 500s are always recorded even when handlers raise.
public_evidence.technical_detail: http_requests_total{method,path,status} counter, http_request_duration_seconds histogram (0.005..10s buckets), active_requests gauge; instrument middleware records status in finally with 500 default.
public_evidence.proof: Triggered a real 500 via dropped table: logs and http_requests_total{status='500'} 1.0 both captured with the same request_id.
public_evidence.ability: Prometheus metrics instrumentation and exception-safe observability.
public_evidence.reviewer_value: Shows production-grade metric design with low-cardinality labels and no silent blind spots.

public_evidence.student_action: Wrote three complete alert rules (HighErrorRate, HighLatency, ServiceDown) with thresholds, for-durations, severities, messages, and runbook links.
public_evidence.technical_detail: rate(5xx[5m])/rate(total[5m]) > 0.05 for 2m critical; histogram_quantile(0.95, rate(_bucket[5m])) > 2 for 3m warning; up == 0 for 1m critical.
public_evidence.proof: observability/prometheus-alerts.yml present; alert math validated against observed 500 counter.
public_evidence.ability: Alert design and on-call contract authoring.
public_evidence.reviewer_value: Demonstrates understanding that alerts are a cost (someone's sleep) and must be calibrated to avoid fatigue.

concepts_demonstrated.evidence: JSON logs with level/message/service_name/request_id; X-Request-ID passthrough.
Counter/histogram/gauge with low-cardinality labels and /metrics endpoint.
Reproduced and fixed the missing-request_id thread in redirect cache logs.
Three rules with thresholds, for-durations, severities, runbooks.

teaching_approaches.detail: Concrete evidence-driven verification of all three pillars
